projects.name: ClauseGuard
projects.description: Multi-agent RAG system that flags risky clauses in contracts. A 4-agent pipeline with hybrid search and cross-encoder reranking, Postgres audit trail for every analysis, and a fine-tuned open-source model benchmarked against a frontier model. Ships with CI/CD and IP-based rate limiting.
